name: Molding
overview: Scripture addresses the practice of molding primarily in the context of creating images and objects, often warning against the making of molten gods as seen in Exodus 32 and Leviticus 19, where Israel fashioned a molten calf contrary to God's commands. The crafting of physical items such as the brass pillars described in 1 Kings 7 demonstrates the skilled artistry involved, yet the emphasis remains on obedience to God's instructions, avoiding idolatry. These passages collectively highlight the tension between human craftsmanship and divine prohibition, underscoring the importance of honoring God rather than turning to fashioned idols.
